The five largest medical device and technology companies in the world by annual sales revenue are Medtronic, Johnson & Johnson (MedTech division), Abbott Laboratories, \[Medline Industries\], and Siemens Healthineers. [](https://www.getreskilled.com/medical-device-companies/)

- **Medtronic:** Global leader in cardiac and vascular devices, neurologic products, and surgical tools.

- **Johnson & Johnson MedTech:** Massive portfolio covering orthopedics, surgery, and vision care.

- **Abbott Laboratories:** Renowned for diabetes care (such as FreeStyle Libre) and cardiovascular diagnostics.

- **Medline Industries:** Major manufacturer and distributor of medical supplies and surgical equipment

- **Siemens Healthineers:** Specialized in diagnostic imaging, laboratory diagnostics, and advanced clinical IT. [](https://www.getreskilled.com/medical-device-companies/)

Smartwatches & Wearable ECG
Function:
Wrist-bound consumer and medical-grade devices capturing optical PPG and electrical heart activity.
Capabilities:
Real-time heart rate monitoring, single-lead ECG recordings for arrhythmia or atrial fibrillation detection, and blood oxygen (SpO₂) tracking.
Examples:
Apple Watch, Withings ScanWatch, and Samsung Galaxy Watch series.
